title: Leaving Auction
statementMd:
There are $*n*$ people taking part in auction today. The rules of auction are classical. There were $*n*$ bids made, though it's not guaranteed they were from different people. It might happen that some people made no bids at all.

Each bid is define by two integers $(*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*})$, where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the index of the person, who made this bid and $*b*_{*i*}$ is its size. Bids are given in chronological order, meaning $*b*_{*i*} < *b*_{*i* + 1}$ for all $*i* < *n*$. Moreover, participant never makes two bids in a row (no one updates his own bid), i.e. $*a*_{*i*} ≠ *a*_{*i* + 1}$ for all $*i* < *n*$.

Now you are curious with the following question: who (and which bid) will win the auction if some participants were absent? Consider that if someone was absent, all his bids are just removed and no new bids are added.

Note, that if during this imaginary exclusion of some participants it happens that some of the remaining participants makes a bid twice (or more times) in a row, only first of these bids is counted. For better understanding take a look at the samples.

You have several questions in your mind, compute the answer for each of them.

## Input

The first line of the input contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of participants and bids.

Each of the following $*n*$ lines contains two integers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}, *b*_{*i*} < *b*_{*i* + 1}$) — the number of participant who made the $*i*$-th bid and the size of this bid.

Next line contains an integer $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *q* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of question you have in mind.

Each of next $*q*$ lines contains an integer $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$), followed by $*k*$ integers $*l*_{*j*}$ ($1 ≤ *l*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$) — the number of people who are not coming in this question and their indices. It is guarenteed that $*l*_{*j*}$ values are different for a single question.

It's guaranteed that the sum of $*k*$ over all question won't exceed $200 000$.

## Output

For each question print two integer — the index of the winner and the size of the winning bid. If there is no winner (there are no remaining bids at all), print two zeroes.

## Note

Consider the first sample:

- In the first question participant number $3$ is absent so the sequence of bids looks as follows: Participant number $2$ wins with the bid $100 000$.
- $1$ $10$
  - $2$ $100$
  - $1$ $10 000$
  - $2$ $100 000$
- In the second question participants $2$ and $3$ are absent, so the sequence of bids looks: The winner is, of course, participant number $1$ but the winning bid is $10$ instead of $10 000$ as no one will ever increase his own bid (in this problem).
- $1$ $10$
  - $1$ $10 000$
- In the third question participants $1$ and $2$ are absent and the sequence is: The winner is participant $3$ with the bid $1 000$.
- $3$ $1 000$
  - $3$ $1 000 000$
statementZhMd:
今天有 $*n*$ 个人参加拍卖。拍卖规则是经典的。总共进行了 $*n*$ 次出价，但不能保证这些出价来自不同的人。也可能有些人一次出价都没有。

每次出价由两个整数 $(*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*})$ 定义，其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 是进行这次出价的人的编号，$*b*_{*i*}$ 是出价金额。出价按照时间顺序给出，这意味着对于所有 $*i* < *n*$，都有 $*b*_{*i*} < *b*_{*i* + 1}$。此外，同一位参与者不会连续出价两次（不会更新自己的出价），即对于所有 $*i* < *n*$，都有 $*a*_{*i*} ≠ *a*_{*i* + 1}$。

现在，你想知道以下问题的答案：如果某些参与者缺席，谁（以及哪一次出价）将赢得拍卖？如果某人缺席，则删除他的所有出价，且不会添加新的出价。

注意，在这种假想地排除某些参与者的过程中，如果剩余参与者中的某人连续出价两次（或更多次），则只计入这些出价中的第一次。请参考样例以便更好地理解。

你心中有若干个问题，请计算每个问题的答案。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$）——参与者和出价的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *n*, 1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}, *b*_{*i*} < *b*_{*i* + 1}$）——进行第 $*i*$ 次出价的参与者编号，以及这次出价的金额。

下一行包含一个整数 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 200 000$）——你提出的问题数量。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行中，每行包含一个整数 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$），后跟 $*k*$ 个整数 $*l*_{*j*}$（$1 ≤ *l*_{*j*} ≤ *n*$）——在该问题中不会出席的参与者数量及其编号。保证同一个问题中的 $*l*_{*j*}$ 互不相同。

保证所有问题中的 $*k*$ 之和不超过 $200 000$。

## 输出格式

对于每个问题，输出两个整数——获胜者的编号以及获胜出价的金额。如果没有获胜者（即没有剩余出价），则输出两个零。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例：

- 在第一个问题中，3 号参与者缺席，因此出价序列如下：2 号参与者以 $100 000$ 的出价获胜。
- $1$ $10$
  - $2$ $100$
  - $1$ $10 000$
  - $2$ $100 000$
- 在第二个问题中，2 号和 3 号参与者缺席，因此出价序列如下：获胜者当然是 1 号参与者，但获胜出价是 $10$，而不是 $10 000$，因为没有人会在本题中提高自己的出价。
- $1$ $10$
  - $1$ $10 000$
- 在第三个问题中，1 号和 2 号参与者缺席，出价序列如下：获胜者是 3 号参与者，出价为 $1 000$。
- $3$ $1 000$
  - $3$ $1 000 000$
